name.es: Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Key Biscayne Village Council took from January 1, 2025 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 36 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. Minutes are posted for only 12 of the 36 meetings; for the rest, the list comes from the agendas and the votes are not shown.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne entre el 1 de enero de 2025 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 36 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Solo hay actas publicadas de 12 de las 36 reuniones; para las demás, la lista viene de las agendas y no muestra los votos.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vilaj Key Biscayne te pran ant 1 janvye 2025 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 36 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Se sèlman pou 12 nan 36 reyinyon yo ki gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye; pou lòt yo, lis la soti nan ajennda yo epi li pa montre vòt yo.

Every other council meeting from 2025-08-19 through 2026-10-13, and the 2025-01-28 special meeting, is agenda-only; their private-party agenda items are listed with roll null
Several minutes PDFs are scans with OCR noise; rolls were read from the "voting Yes / voting No" lists and checked by hand for split votes
Councilmember Bracken recused himself on the 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard site plan; he is marked absent in that roll
Applicants or owners are not named in titles for the variances at 920 Mariner Drive and 640 South Mashta Drive, or for the 101 Harbor Drive rezoning
Workshops (infrastructure, undergrounding, shoreline, swale, budget, Zone 1) take no votes and are not listed
